# Sarvlekh (सर्वलेख)

> Sarvlekh is a premium business systems studio in India. We build connected software, accounting (Tally, GST, TDS, payroll) and workflow automation for hostels, PGs, clinics, messes, laundries, schools, coaching institutes, media houses, finance companies, RMC plants, manufacturing plants, retail and wholesale stores, gyms, restaurants, showrooms, hotels, weighbridges, mines and more. "Sarvlekh" is Sanskrit: sarva = all, lekh = record — "the record of everything".

Contact: connect@sarvlekh.in

## Industry pages
- [Hostel](https://www.sarvlekh.in/industries/hostel/): Sarvlekh builds hostel management systems: room allocation, rent and mess billing, gate pass, complaints, attendance and parent alerts — in one connected app.
- [PG & Co-living](https://www.sarvlekh.in/industries/pg/): PG and co-living management software by Sarvlekh: tenant onboarding, KYC, rent collection, electricity split, food menu, complaints and owner analytics.
- [Doctor & Clinic](https://www.sarvlekh.in/industries/clinic/): Sarvlekh clinic software: appointments, queue, e-prescription, patient records, lab and pharmacy billing, follow-up reminders and doctor dashboards.
- [Mess & Canteen](https://www.sarvlekh.in/industries/mess/): Sarvlekh mess management: meal plans, attendance, coupon and QR billing, kitchen stock, wastage control and monthly statements for hostels, offices and institutions.
- [Laundry & Dry Clean](https://www.sarvlekh.in/industries/laundry/): Sarvlekh laundry software: barcode garment tagging, pickup and delivery routes, per-piece and per-kg pricing, hostel bulk laundry, billing and customer alerts.
- [School](https://www.sarvlekh.in/industries/school/): Sarvlekh school ERP: admissions, fees, attendance, timetable, exams and report cards, transport, library, parent app and management dashboards.
- [Coaching Institute](https://www.sarvlekh.in/industries/coaching/): Coaching class software by Sarvlekh: batch scheduling, student CRM, fee installments, online tests, performance analytics, faculty payroll and parent app.
- [Media House](https://www.sarvlekh.in/industries/media-house/): Sarvlekh media workflow system: content calendar, assignments, asset library, approvals, ad and client billing, freelancer payments and team productivity.
- [Finance & Lending](https://www.sarvlekh.in/industries/finance/): Sarvlekh finance software: loan origination, EMI schedules, collections app, ledgers, KYC, reconciliation and MIS dashboards for NBFCs, chit funds and lenders.
- [Tally & Accounting](https://www.sarvlekh.in/industries/tally-accounting/): Sarvlekh accounting services: Tally integration, GST filing support, bookkeeping, bank reconciliation, payroll, TDS and automated reports for growing Indian businesses.
- [RMC Plant](https://www.sarvlekh.in/industries/rmc/): Sarvlekh RMC software: concrete orders, mix designs, batching records, transit-mixer dispatch, weighbridge, quality tests, GST billing and customer ledgers.
- [Manufacturing Plant](https://www.sarvlekh.in/industries/manufacturing/): Sarvlekh manufacturing ERP: BOM, production planning, shop-floor tracking, inventory, quality, maintenance, costing and dispatch for MSME and mid-size plants.
- [Retail Outlet](https://www.sarvlekh.in/industries/retail-outlet/): Sarvlekh retail software: POS billing, barcode inventory, multi-store stock, loyalty, offers, GST invoices, supplier orders and sales analytics.
- [Wholesale Store](https://www.sarvlekh.in/industries/wholesale/): Sarvlekh wholesale software: salesman order app, party ledgers, credit limits, batch stock, scheme management, delivery routes, GST billing and collections.
- [Gym & Fitness](https://www.sarvlekh.in/industries/gym/): Sarvlekh gym software: memberships, biometric/QR attendance, auto-renewal, trainer scheduling, diet and workout plans, POS and retention analytics.
- [Restaurant](https://www.sarvlekh.in/industries/restaurant/): Sarvlekh restaurant software: POS, KOT and kitchen display, table management, online order aggregation, recipe inventory, staff and GST reporting.
- [Showroom](https://www.sarvlekh.in/industries/showroom/): Sarvlekh showroom software: lead CRM, test drives, quotations, finance and insurance, inventory, delivery, service jobcards and spare parts for dealerships.
- [Hotel](https://www.sarvlekh.in/industries/hotel/): Sarvlekh hotel software: property management, channel-ready bookings, front desk, housekeeping, F&B billing, laundry, night audit and revenue dashboards.
- [Weighbridge](https://www.sarvlekh.in/industries/weighbridge/): Sarvlekh weighbridge software: automatic weight capture, vehicle and party records, weighment slips, camera proof, billing and fraud-proof reports for yards and plants.
- [Mines & Quarries](https://www.sarvlekh.in/industries/mines/): Sarvlekh mining software: production logs, dispatch and weighbridge, royalty and permit tracking, fleet and fuel, stock yards, workforce and compliance reports.

## Services
- [Custom Business Software](https://www.sarvlekh.in/services/business-software/): Sarvlekh designs custom ERP, mobile apps, dashboards and integrations (Tally, GST, UPI, WhatsApp, biometrics) for hostels, clinics, plants, stores and more.
- [Accounting & Compliance](https://www.sarvlekh.in/services/accounting/): Sarvlekh offers bookkeeping, Tally accounting, GST return preparation, TDS, payroll, bank reconciliation and MIS — connected to your operations software.
- [Business Optimisation](https://www.sarvlekh.in/services/business-optimisation/): Sarvlekh maps your workflows, removes repetitive work and automates approvals, reminders and reports — saving labour hours and cutting leakage.

## Quick answers
**What is Sarvlekh?** Sarvlekh is a premium business systems studio. We design the software, accounting and operating systems that run hostels, clinics, schools, plants, stores, hotels and 20+ other kinds of business — all connected in one place.

**What does the name Sarvlekh mean?** Sarvlekh comes from Sanskrit: "sarva" means all and "lekh" means record or writing. It means the record of everything — the promise that every part of your business is written down clearly and kept in order.

**Which businesses does Sarvlekh serve?** We serve hostels, PGs, clinics, messes, laundries, schools, coaching institutes, media houses, finance companies, Tally and accounting firms, RMC plants, manufacturing plants, retail stores, wholesalers, gyms, restaurants, showrooms, hotels, weighbridges and mines — and many more on request.

**What does "a system that makes a system" mean?** We do not hand you a fixed product. We build a flexible core platform, then shape modules, workflows and reports around how your business actually works, so the system grows when your business grows.

**Does Sarvlekh also provide accounting services?** Yes. Along with software we offer bookkeeping, Tally, GST, TDS, payroll and MIS services, connected to your operations so entries are made once.

**How does Sarvlekh reduce labour and worker hours?** By replacing manual registers, repeated entries, phone-call coordination and month-end scrambles with automated workflows, reminders and live dashboards.

**Is Sarvlekh software mobile friendly?** Yes. Every Sarvlekh system is designed phone-first, with separate mobile layouts and apps for staff, customers, parents and field teams.

**How do I start working with Sarvlekh?** Email connect@sarvlekh.in with a few lines about your business. We will set up a discovery conversation, map your workflows and propose a clear first release.
